definitions.same_fault: Same question, tool name, canonical arguments, original OCR text and injected OCR text.
definitions.effective_recognition_fault: Recognition questions where original OCR contains the answer and injected OCR does not.
definitions.copy_proxy: Normalized final answer occurs in injected OCR text but not in original OCR text; lexical proxy, not a semantic judgment.
definitions.natural_error: Fixed base/clean full-image OCR recognition errors under benchmark lexical scoring; inspect examples before claiming genuine OCR failures.
definitions.tool_use: Includes attempted tool calls; report both fraction of questions with a call and calls per question.

interpretation: Primary comparison uses base, vanilla53 and v2_step40; step50 is a separate supplementary comparison.
Report intersection size, paired gains/losses and clean guardrails before making a decision; a small or noisy cohort is inconclusive.
Improvement for both error types with clean guardrails supports repaired 64-GPU v3.
Training-type improvement alone calls for more realistic faults and a repaired 16-GPU pilot.
No reliable improvement calls for a repaired 16-GPU pilot; it does not alone prove all earlier gains came from bypasses.
GPU evaluation and training submission are outside this CPU report process.
